name: Immersive Enemies
author: Zenith
description: Physics-driven Nauvis & Gleba enemy ragdolls (biters, spitters, worms, nests, wrigglers, strafers, stompers & egg rafts) with spring/articulated legs, explosive body splitting, burning-to-ash corpses, progressive wounds, pooled splatter/gibs, slimy acid goo, and reworked animations.
